/.title: Swechha — Delhi environmental NGO. We keep the record.
/.indexName: Delhi environmental NGO. We keep the record.
/.description: Swechha is an environmental NGO in Delhi, working since 2000. Air, the Yamuna, schools, journeys and a five-acre farm — every figure with its source.

/about.title: About Swechha — an environmental NGO in Delhi
/about.indexName: About Swechha — an environmental NGO in Delhi
/about.description: Founded in 2000 as We for Yamuna. Swechha is an environmental and community organisation in Delhi — who does the work, who governs it, what is on record.

/act.title: Get involved — give, volunteer or partner — Swechha
/act.indexName: Get involved — give, volunteer or partner
/act.description: Three ways in: give to an NGO with 80G and 12A, turn up and volunteer, or bring us a ward, a river stretch or a cohort. Every ask on this site lands here.

/farm.title: Swechha Farm — school camps, trips and stays near Delhi
/farm.indexName: Swechha Farm — school camps and stays near Delhi
/farm.description: Five acres in the Aravallis, ninety minutes from Delhi. Day trips, overnight school camps for a hundred students, retreats and stays. One tree became 5,000.

/healthy-cities.title: Healthy Cities — Delhi schools, Influence Fellows — Swechha
/healthy-cities.description: Air, water, waste and food taught as health in twenty-six Delhi-NCR schools, and ten Influence Fellows funded to pilot their own idea in eight states.

/healthy-cities/fellows/anjali-choudhary.title: Anjali Choudhary — composting in Bharuch schools — Swechha
/healthy-cities/fellows/anjali-choudhary.description: Composting units in Bharuch schools, offices and an orphanage, 677 people sensitised, and one site now taking 180 to 200 kilos of wet waste a day.

/healthy-cities/fellows/mansi-thakar-jan.title: Mansi Thakar Jani — Gujarat water heritage — Swechha
/healthy-cities/fellows/mansi-thakar-jan.indexName: Mansi Thakar Jani — Gujarat water heritage
/healthy-cities/fellows/mansi-thakar-jan.description: Munsar Lake, the Saptamukhi stepwell and Valavav: four events across Gujarat, about seven hundred people, and volunteers trained to watch the sites after.

/healthy-cities/fellows/miyawaki-forests.title: Palak Bajpai — Miyawaki forests in Uttar Pradesh — Swechha
/healthy-cities/fellows/miyawaki-forests.description: Four dense forests on school and college ground, 1,025 plants across 2,120 square feet, planted on four days, with 435 held back for the next one.

/healthy-cities/fellows/s-vineeth-kumar.title: S Vineeth Kumar — Napier grass on Karnataka farms — Swechha
/healthy-cities/fellows/s-vineeth-kumar.indexName: S Vineeth Kumar — Napier grass in Karnataka
/healthy-cities/fellows/s-vineeth-kumar.description: Five farmers, five acres and four harvests of Napier grass in Chikaballapura, plus the variety trials that named Pangong-3 the one worth planting.

/healthy-cities/fellows/shubham-dipak-gu.title: Shubham Dipak Gurav — natural farming in Sangli — Swechha
/healthy-cities/fellows/shubham-dipak-gu.indexName: Shubham Dipak Gurav — natural farming in Sangli
/healthy-cities/fellows/shubham-dipak-gu.description: Four Natural Farming Schools across four Sangli villages: jeevamrut and neemastra made on the farm, in drums the farmers keep, for 150 people.

/healthy-cities/fellows/shubham-panwar.title: Shubham Panwar — mushroom farming in Uttarkashi — Swechha
/healthy-cities/fellows/shubham-panwar.description: Forty women, two units, four hundred kilos of straw that was not burnt, and seventy kilos of mushrooms from the first cycle in an Uttarkashi winter.

/healthy-cities/fellows/swapnil-chaurasi.title: Swapnil Chaurasiya — waste segregation in Bilaspur — Swechha
/healthy-cities/fellows/swapnil-chaurasi.indexName: Swapnil Chaurasiya — waste segregation in Bilaspur
/healthy-cities/fellows/swapnil-chaurasi.description: Segregation at home went from 24 to 80 per cent in Bilaspur, and children reminding their families from 9 to 76. Measured before and after it.

/healthy-cities/fellows/taniya-gill.title: Taniya Gill — native plant workshops in Delhi — Swechha
/healthy-cities/fellows/taniya-gill.indexName: Taniya Gill — native plants in Delhi
/healthy-cities/fellows/taniya-gill.description: Three nature journaling workshops in Delhi, ten native species observed and a journal each to keep. Children, students, artists, the queer community.

/healthy-cities/fellows/tanuz-kalita.title: Tanuz Kalita — riverbank saplings in Majuli — Swechha
/healthy-cities/fellows/tanuz-kalita.indexName: Tanuz Kalita — riverbank saplings in Majuli
/healthy-cities/fellows/tanuz-kalita.description: Three thousand native saplings into the eroding banks at Salmora and Karatipar, and fifty kilos of weaving thread to the households living on them.

/healthy-cities/fellows/tawheed-zubair.title: Tawheed Zubair — school saplings in Moradabad — Swechha
/healthy-cities/fellows/tawheed-zubair.indexName: Tawheed Zubair — school saplings in Moradabad
/healthy-cities/fellows/tawheed-zubair.description: Three Moradabad schools, two parks and 235 native and medicinal saplings, kept alive by five Tree Monitors per school. 88 per cent of the saplings lived.

/impact.title: Impact: youth, school and volunteer figures — Swechha
/impact.description: Every figure Swechha holds, on one page, by programme and by the span it counts. No single total: the figures count overlapping groups of people.

/now.title: Environmental readings for Delhi and India — Swechha
/now.description: Six environmental readings Swechha keeps: Delhi's air, the Yamuna, heat, forest fire, forest loss and extreme rain, each against the standard that governs it.

/now/air.title: Delhi air pollution, tracked hourly by an NGO — Swechha
/now/air.description: Delhi’s air pollution, read hourly against CPCB’s own published limit by the NGO behind this record, with the station and time on every reading.

/now/air/india.title: Every Indian city’s air quality index — Swechha
/now/air/india.description: Every city reporting to CPCB, ranked on its worst monitor against the AQI 100 limit India set for itself, with the average CPCB publishes beside it.

/now/climate-event.title: India’s extreme rain — Swechha
/now/climate-event.description: India's extreme rain, read against IMD's own 24-hour rainfall categories, with the official table behind every figure and what it leaves out.

/now/forest-fire.title: India’s forest fires — Swechha
/now/forest-fire.description: India's forest fires, read from the Forest Survey of India's burnt-area record and NASA FIRMS detections, with what each source can and cannot count.

/now/forest-loss.title: India’s forest loss — Swechha
/now/forest-loss.description: India's forest loss, read from three sources that disagree — and two of them are not independent, which matters more than the disagreement does.

/now/heat.title: India heatwave data, from IMD criteria — Swechha
/now/heat.description: India's heat, read from IMD's own heat-wave criteria and NCRB's death table, with the source, the year and the limits of the count on every figure.

/now/yamuna.title: Yamuna pollution in Delhi, against CPCB class C — Swechha
/now/yamuna.description: The Yamuna through Delhi, read against CPCB's own class C standard, with the monitoring station, the sampling method and the date on every figure.

/publications.title: Free environmental books and research — Swechha
/publications.description: Three things Swechha has published, free and whole, with no address asked for: a book about a neighbourhood, a shopper's guide, and one piece of research.

/search.title: Search every page on this environmental site — Swechha
/search.description: Search every page on swechha.in by title, section heading and opening line — or read the whole list below, in the order the site is arranged.

/stories.title: Environmental stories, films and essays — Swechha
/stories.description: Films made with the people in them, and a poster series that said the same things on paper, in a city that reads walls before it reads reports.

/stories/climate-crisis-uk-and-europe.title: Climate crisis in the UK and Europe — Swechha
/stories/climate-crisis-uk-and-europe.indexName: Climate crisis in the UK and Europe
/stories/climate-crisis-uk-and-europe.description: The scorching European summer, read as a climate event rather than a heatwave story. An essay for Swechha by Richa Mirdha on the UK and Europe.

/stories/cyclone-biparjoy.title: Cyclone Biparjoy: a climate essay — Swechha
/stories/cyclone-biparjoy.description: Cyclone Biparjoy, named by Bangladesh, and what a cyclone's approach asks of the coast it is heading for. An essay for Swechha by Antarixa Bhardwaj.

/stories/increasing-climate-migration-as.title: Increasing climate migration due to Assam floods — Swechha
/stories/increasing-climate-migration-as.indexName: Increasing climate migration due to Assam floods
/stories/increasing-climate-migration-as.description: Assam's floods displace people every year and rehabilitation is the part nobody follows. An essay for Swechha by Tanya Mittal on India's climate migrants.

/stories/rise-above-the-waters.title: Rise above the waters — Swechha
/stories/rise-above-the-waters.description: Bengaluru's monsoon is a delight on social media and a disaster by September. An essay for Swechha by Antarixa Bhardwaj on what the flood story leaves out.

/stories/young-people-accelerate-climate.title: High time young people accelerate climate action — Swechha
/stories/young-people-accelerate-climate.indexName: High time young people accelerate climate action
/stories/young-people-accelerate-climate.description: The climate crisis is a transgenerational problem, not an academic one. An essay for Swechha by Tanya Mittal on what it asks of young people, and how soon.

/work.title: Environmental and education work in Delhi — Swechha
/work.description: Everything Swechha runs, in one view: every project, campaign, journey and event, by name, with the kind of work it is set on the row beside it.

/work/campaigns.title: Environmental campaigns in Delhi NCR — Swechha
/work/campaigns.description: Public pressure with a name on it, from We for Yamuna in 2000 to Monsoon Wooding. The campaigns, by name, and what each one of them pushes against.

/work/campaigns/monsoon-wooding.title: Monsoon Wooding — tree planting in Delhi NCR — Swechha
/work/campaigns/monsoon-wooding.description: Planting through the monsoon across Delhi NCR. About 5,000 trees a year and over 50,000 planted and survived, counted as survivors against a planting count.

/work/events.title: Environmental events and workshops in Delhi — Swechha
/work/events.description: Workshops, concerts, plays and river clean-ups — the gatherings Swechha runs in public, from Yamunotsav to the Greenathon and the Yamuna Shramdaan.

/work/journeys.title: Journeys — school camps and walks — Swechha
/work/journeys.description: School journeys and camps, two hours to twelve days: a city walk, a forest, a village, and a thousand kilometres down the Yamuna. The oldest runs since 2004.

/work/journeys/cityscapes.title: CityScapes — city nature walks for schools — Swechha
/work/journeys/cityscapes.description: Two to four hours inside Delhi, at six places it would rather you did not look at: the river, a landfill, a city forest. Over a thousand walks in two decades.

/work/journeys/gram-anubhav.title: Gram Anubhav — school journeys into villages — Swechha
/work/journeys/gram-anubhav.description: Four to five days living in a village in Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, Gujarat or Himachal. Over sixty journeys run, with over a hundred partners in the villages.

/work/journeys/naturescapes.title: NatureScapes — school nature camps — Swechha
/work/journeys/naturescapes.description: Two to five days in a forest, a mountain, a desert or a mangrove: Sariska, Ranthambore, Corbett, Jaisalmer, the Sunderbans. Over sixty journeys organised.

/work/journeys/yamuna-yatra.title: Yamuna Yatra — a journey down the river — Swechha
/work/journeys/yamuna-yatra.description: Twelve days and about a thousand kilometres down the Yamuna, from Yamunotri to Agra. Thirty Yatras since 2004, and ten thousand young people through them.

/work/projects.title: Environmental education projects in Delhi — Swechha
/work/projects.description: The work that runs for years rather than days: a school curriculum on land, water and air, a five-acre learning farm, butterfly parks, and a volunteer corps.

/work/projects/bridge-the-gap.title: Bridge the Gap — a school curriculum in Delhi — Swechha
/work/projects/bridge-the-gap.description: A module-based school curriculum on land, water and air: five to sixteen sessions, plus exposure trips and action projects. 100-150 Delhi schools every year.

/work/projects/eco-action.title: Eco Action — butterfly parks across Delhi NCR — Swechha
/work/projects/eco-action.description: Butterfly parks and herb gardens built with schools and residents across Delhi NCR: over seventy parks and over twenty gardens planted so far.

/work/projects/farm-school.title: Farm School — a working farm for students — Swechha
/work/projects/farm-school.description: A learning lab on five acres, ninety minutes from Delhi. Day visits, short courses, internships and stays, with the composting and the nursery as the class.

/work/projects/influence.title: Influence — a fellowship and youth network — Swechha
/work/projects/influence.description: Volunteering and a fellowship, nationwide: ten fellows a year, ten thousand volunteers a year, fifty colleges, and a network of over 300 youth groups.

/work/projects/me-to-we.title: ME to WE — a youth leadership programme in Delhi — Swechha
/work/projects/me-to-we.description: A leadership programme run with children from one settlement in south Delhi. Over 3,000 through it in thirteen years, and over 200 back as peer leaders.

/work/campaigns/no-plastic.title: No Plastic — ten posters on plastic pollution — Swechha
/work/campaigns/no-plastic.description: Ten A3 sheets made with GIZ on single-use plastic, marine litter, microplastics and extended producer responsibility. The whole set, as printed.

/posters.title: Posters — printed campaign material — Swechha
/posters.description: Swechha's printed campaign sheets, shown whole rather than cropped. Ten posters on single-use plastic made with GIZ, each with the credit it carries.

/learn.title: Learn: environmental data explained — Swechha
/learn.description: Swechha's environmental knowledge library. What India's air, river, heat, forest and rainfall numbers mean, who sets the limits, and what each cannot say.

/learn/delhi-aqi.title: What is Delhi’s AQI? A simple guide — Swechha
/learn/delhi-aqi.description: Delhi's Air Quality Index explained: the six CPCB bands, why the number is a worst case rather than an average, and the standard it is measured against.

/learn/pm25.title: What is PM2.5? Delhi’s fine particles — Swechha
/learn/pm25.description: PM2.5 explained: why particle size decides the harm, where Delhi's fine particulates come from, and the CPCB standard of 60 micrograms per cubic metre.

/learn/pm10.title: What is PM10? Coarse dust in Delhi’s air — Swechha
/learn/pm10.description: PM10 explained: the coarse fraction from dust, roads and construction, how it differs from PM2.5, and the CPCB 24-hour standard of 100 micrograms.

/learn/delhi-air-pollution.title: Why is Delhi’s air pollution so bad? — Swechha
/learn/delhi-air-pollution.description: A basin that traps winter air, a regional airshed larger than the city, and particles that form in the atmosphere. What Delhi's pollution is made of.

/learn/source-apportionment.title: Source apportionment in Delhi’s air — Swechha
/learn/source-apportionment.description: How a share of air pollution gets assigned to a source, why receptor and dispersion models disagree, and what Delhi's two government studies each found.

/learn/cpcb-aqi.title: What does the CPCB air quality index measure? — Swechha
/learn/cpcb-aqi.description: The CPCB National Air Quality Index explained: eight pollutants, sub-indices, the minimum-three rule, and the difference between city and station figures.

/learn/yamuna-pollution.title: Why is the Yamuna so polluted in Delhi? — Swechha
/learn/yamuna-pollution.description: Most of the Yamuna's flow is taken out at Wazirabad and drains replace it. What CPCB's own river monitoring shows across the Delhi stretch, station by station

/learn/yamuna-dissolved-oxygen.title: Dissolved oxygen in the Yamuna, explained — Swechha
/learn/yamuna-dissolved-oxygen.description: Dissolved oxygen explained: what it measures, why it collapses below Wazirabad, the 5 mg/L bathing criterion, and why a reading of 0.3 is not zero.

/learn/yamuna-bod.title: What is BOD? Yamuna water pollution — Swechha
/learn/yamuna-bod.description: Biochemical oxygen demand explained: the five-day test, why it is the standard measure of organic pollution, and how Delhi's Yamuna stations read against it.

/learn/india-heatwave.title: What is a heatwave in India? — Swechha
/learn/india-heatwave.description: A heatwave in India is a defined event, not simply a hot day. The IMD criteria, why they are relative to local normals, and what the definition leaves out.

/learn/imd-heatwave-criteria.title: IMD heatwave criteria for India, explained — Swechha
/learn/imd-heatwave-criteria.description: India's heatwave rule gate by gate: the zone floors of 40, 37 and 30 degrees, the departure thresholds, and the absolute override at 45 and 47 degrees.

/learn/heatwave-vs-extreme-heat.title: Heatwave vs extreme heat in India — Swechha
/learn/heatwave-vs-extreme-heat.description: A heatwave is a declared meteorological event. Extreme heat is what harms people. Why humidity, night temperature and exposure fall outside the criteria.

/learn/forest-cover-vs-tree-cover.title: Forest cover vs tree cover in India — Swechha
/learn/forest-cover-vs-tree-cover.description: India's two official forest classes explained: what counts as forest cover at 10 per cent canopy, what tree cover adds, and why neither means an ecosystem.

/learn/tree-cover-loss.title: What tree-cover loss means for India — Swechha
/learn/tree-cover-loss.description: Tree-cover loss is canopy disappearing, not deforestation. Why the canopy threshold changes the answer, and why the thresholds must never be added together.

/learn/forest-loss-india.title: Is India losing forest? The data — Swechha
/learn/forest-loss-india.description: India's own report records a net forest gain while the satellite series records loss. Both are right, and the reason is the definition, with the arithmetic.

/learn/extreme-rainfall.title: What counts as extreme rainfall in India? — Swechha
/learn/extreme-rainfall.description: IMD's 24-hour rain categories explained: heavy at 64.5 mm, very heavy at 115.6, extremely heavy at 204.5, and why a day is the wrong unit for a cloudburst.

/learn/delhi-rainfall.title: How Delhi rainfall is measured — Swechha
/learn/delhi-rainfall.description: How Delhi's rain is recorded, which gauge the headline figure comes from, and why a seasonal normal is a climatological average rather than any kind of limit.

/learn/forest-fires-india.title: Forest fires in India: what the data counts — Swechha
/learn/forest-fires-india.description: India's fire figures count satellite detections, not fires and not forest fires. What a hot pixel is, what it misses, and how a comparable series is built.

/learn/measured-vs-modelled.title: Measured vs modelled environmental data — Swechha
/learn/measured-vs-modelled.description: The first question to ask of any environmental number. How measurements fail, how models fail, and why the two kinds cannot be compared or averaged together.

/learn/how-to-read-environmental-data.title: How to read environmental data — Swechha
/learn/how-to-read-environmental-data.description: Seven questions that catch most ways a true environmental number becomes a false claim: the limit, who set it, the method, the period and the baseline.

/schools.title: School trips and environmental education — Swechha
/schools.description: Environmental school programmes from Delhi: half-day city walks, farm days, multi-day journeys and a year-long curriculum. What each covers and how to book.

/record.title: The environmental record — Delhi and India — Swechha
/record.description: Swechha keeps every reading at its own address, with its source, its observation time and the limit it was judged against. Nothing is overwritten, ever.

/record/air.title: Delhi air quality record — hourly archive — Swechha
/record/air.description: An hourly archive of Delhi air quality from CPCB network readings, kept with the worst monitor named and every revision the source made after publication.

/use-the-data.title: Use Swechha’s environmental data — Swechha
/use-the-data.description: Licence, attribution and method for every environmental reading Swechha publishes, with what each source does not cover. Open under CC BY 4.0 and reusable.

/journal.title: The Journal — India environment analysis — Swechha
/journal.description: Dated analysis and reporting on India’s environment, written against the readings Swechha keeps. Every figure snapshotted with the moment it was observed.

/journal/delhi-is-not-one-city.title: Delhi is not one city, and its air proves it — Swechha
/journal/delhi-is-not-one-city.indexName: Delhi’s air is not one number
/journal/delhi-is-not-one-city.description: On one September evening one Delhi monitor read 35 and another read 211. What a 176-point spread across forty-five CPCB stations says about a city average.

/journal/one-state-lost-twice-the-nation.title: One state lost twice India’s national forest gain — Swechha
/journal/one-state-lost-twice-the-nation.description: India’s forest report records a net gain of 156 sq km while Madhya Pradesh alone lost 371. The arithmetic, the definitions, and the claim that survives both.
